OGUN (PSI 9.7): Governor Dapo Abiodun signed historic MoUs with DP World MEA FZE in Paris for the Gateway Deep Sea Port and 10,000-hectare Blue Marine SEZ, witnessed by President Bola Tinubu, attracting over $7bn initial investment.

LAGOS (PSI 9.6): Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu addressed the UN Climate Action meeting alongside California Gov. Gavin Newsom, highlighting green transport for 5.2m vehicles, while witnessing the US-Nigeria $700bn mineral resource framework.

ADAMAWA (PSI 9.5): Governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri approved a N169.1bn supplementary budget expanding the 2026 budget to N752.4bn, awarding contracts for N11.3bn drainage, N10.5bn stadium works, N6.3bn solar lights, and N3.3bn power restoration.

KATSINA (PSI 9.4): Governor Dikko Umaru Radda presented the Northwest Security and Development Framework at UNGA 81 on behalf of seven Northwest Governors, and urged global investors at the ASIS Forum to finance agricultural processing.

EDO (PSI 9.2): ESERC issued an interim power licence to BEDC Electricity Edo Limited to run the state power market under the 2025 Edo Electricity Law, while the state engaged NIPCO Gas on CNG infrastructure and inspected 83 Division site.

PLATEAU (PSI 9.1): Transport Commissioner Davou Gyang Jatau suspended field VIO road operations until Sept 27 following motorist assaults, initiating an advocacy tour with NUJ, FRSC, and NBA to review enforcement protocols.

ONDO (PSI 9.0): Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa promised expanded health funding and Hospitals Management Board inauguration to NMA, while Agriculture Ministry partnered with 32 Artillery Brigade on cassava farming inside Owena Barracks.

TARABA (PSI 8.9): Governor Agbu Kefas met Chief of Army Staff Lt. Gen. Waidi Shaibu in Abuja to enhance military troop deployment, operational logistics, and civil-military cooperation to safeguard rural farming communities.

RIVERS (PSI 8.8): Deputy Governor Prof. Ngozi Nma Odu, representing Governor Siminalayi Fubara, announced a 50 percent increase in judicial overhead funding at the 2026/2027 Legal Year opening to upgrade facilities and digital case management.

OSUN (PSI 8.7): Deputy Governor Prince Kola Adewusi, representing Governor Ademola Adeleke, highlighted 40 new UNIOSUN building projects and confirmed a 2-year tenure extension for VC Prof. Clement Adebooye under amended state law.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.6): FCT Minister Nyesom Wike inspected satellite town projects, guaranteeing handover of the Apo-Karshi road by November and Bwari-Kubwa road by December 2026.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.5): Health Commissioner Dr. Nafisa Maradun opened a 2-day WHO-supported training workshop for LGA stakeholders in Gusau to formulate the 2027 Health Annual Operational Plan.

SOKOTO (PSI 8.4): Governor Ahmed Aliyu opened the 8th State Executive Council meeting, pledging sustained anti-banditry operations until IDPs return home, following successful bandit engagements and livestock recovery in Rabah, Tureta, and Kebbe.

KADUNA (PSI 8.3): SSG Dr. Abdulkadir Meyere, Head of Service Jummai Bako, and Health Commissioner Umma Ahmed led KADCHMA's workshop engaging political appointees to drive Universal Health Coverage enrollment.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.2): Governor Umo Eno presented certificates of recognition to newly recognized traditional rulers in Uyo and announced an upward review of their welfare packages to strengthen grassroots governance.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.1): Health Commissioner Dr. Henry Ayuk officially reopened General Hospital Obudu with a new management team, and reaffirmed 100% state ownership of College of Nursing Sciences Ogoja.
